name: status-line-run-timer
title: Replace pi-timer with a status-line run timer
description: Drop the npm:pi-timer package, which replaces Pi's built-in footer wholesale and silently removes its cache-hit percentage, and publish a hand-placed run timer through ctx.ui.setStatus() on the footer status line instead. Deletes pi-agent/extensions/cache-hit-rate.ts, whose only job was to repair the segment pi-timer dropped.
creator: tan
